data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 5.786 million, representing a 9.59% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by good experience on longer tail and Specialty classes for the 2021 and 2022 underwriting years.

The Chairman's statement mentions underlying LOBs of the host syndicate (Property, Marine, Specialty, US Professional Lines) but these are not direct LOBs for Syndicate 6117.
